puzzle.body: Add support for dynamic field mapping. Let's add support for dynamic field mapping, user will define his own mapping in `.yml` file, we will parse that and apply it when writing results to the files. e.g.: name: result.nameWithOwner, etc. In this case `result` should be bindable only in that `.yml` config.
